step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows a multi-account IoT SaaS platform design by Eclorvalle. On the left is the customer's AWS Account ('Your AWS Account') receiving data from IoT devices via a local Gateway to AWS IoT Core, and user requests from a mobile App to Amazon Cognito. Inside the customer account, serverless components including Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, SNS, and S3 handle data processing, storage, monitoring, and notifications. On the right, the SaaS vendor manages an 'IoT Portal' hosted inside a VPC on Amazon EC2 with AWS Auto Scaling and Amazon RDS, accessed by Business Users. AWS IAM enables cross-account management and access control between the vendor portal and the customer account.
